name: obsidian-knowledge-workspace
description: A local personal knowledge workspace for long-term learning, work, projects and research, with source-aware Codex retrieval and scheduled upkeep.

interface.shortDescription: Build, search and maintain your personal knowledge
interface.longDescription: Connect local learning notes, project material, work records and research to an Obsidian vault. Let Codex retrieve relevant evidence and maintain it on your chosen schedule.
defaultPrompt: Connect my local material to a personal knowledge workspace and arrange weekly upkeep.
Search my knowledge workspace for relevant sources before answering.
Organize new material and save a source-linked note.
